items.title: what browser you use for streaming on mfc?
items.content:
i used to stream with obs and chrome browser, then i only used stream master and their build in obs. both worked well. i haven’t changed anything in the settings, my internet speed is very good, yet my streaming now is lagging like crazy. it s been a while and i haven’t figured it out…   
on top of that!!! when i am online, if im resizing my web page, it s suddenly saying that the obs it s not connected anymore. can anybody help me please? i am going crazy

items.title: Please help. CB tags
items.content:
Babes. Ladies. Gents. Theys and thems. I am having trouble getting people in my room on CB even with my new tag. I make sure to be conscious of my thumbnail while working. My camera and lighting are decent. I chat people up and make sure I’m engaging… at this point the only thing I can think of is that I’m not using the right tags. Right now I’m using: bigboobs, bigass, ebony, twerk, and lovense.

I can post a pic of myself in the comments if that helps people brainstorm, but all of those tags do apply to me 😅..

I’ve only been camming for 2 weeks and I have 1,500 followers which is nice and thankfully I banked a whale in my first week so he saves me from having any nights where I make less than $80/100… but I don’t wanna depend on him.

I’m literally getting like 30/40 people in my rooms

replied.post_title: Videos v Live that are sold
replied.reply_text: Great question! Both have their pros and cons. Live shows offer real-time connection and tipping, which can be great for building regulars. Recorded videos work passively — you create once and sell repeatedly. Many successful models do both: use live shows to build an audience and then sell custom videos or a content library. What platform are you mainly working on? That might help narrow down which works better for you!
replied.note: cached_fresh_activity (13 hours ago), new member question

replied.reply_text: A few things that really help boost earnings: having a consistent schedule so fans know when to find you, engaging with your chat room even during slow periods, using tip goals to keep viewers motivated, and promoting on social media before your streams. Also, Lovense toys with tip-activated vibrations can be a great engagement tool! What platform are you streaming on?

replied.reply_text: Hi there! If you are having trouble with your Lush 4, make sure it is fully charged and that Bluetooth is enabled on your device. Open the Lovense app and try re-pairing the toy. If you are using it with the Cam Extension for streaming, check that the toy shows as connected in the app first. If issues persist, the support team at camming@lovense.com can help! 💙

replied.post_title: I need most help with marketing and room engagement
replied.reply_text: Marketing and engagement are so key! A few things that have helped me: posting on social media with a consistent schedule (Twitter/X is very cam-model friendly), using tip goals and countdowns to keep the room energy up, and always talking to your room even when it is quiet — it shows you are active and pulls people in. Also, Lovense Cam Extension has some great interactive features that can really boost engagement. What platform are you on?
